name: Sara Chrysalis
source:
A character from the London chapter.

Hobby: Collecting stuffed animals (but she keeps it as a secret from everyone) 
Favorite food: Pudding, tea.
Hated food: Coffee, citrus fruits.
Affiliation: Prep Class 1-A.
